name: asym_vol_reversal
description: 该因子衡量个股在过去一段时间内，负收益对应的波动强度相对于正收益对应的波动强度的非对称性。若负向波动显著高于正向波动，通常意味着市场对坏消息存在更强烈的情绪化过度反应与抛压拥挤，后续更容易发生价格反转。因此，该因子将“负向波动相对正向波动更高”的股票视为更可能获得未来短中期超额收益的对象。
code:
def builder(prices, *, window=20, skip_recent=5, min_periods=None, **kwargs):
    # Asymmetric Volatility Reversal
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    factor_name = "asym_vol_reversal"

    frame = prices.copy()
    frame["date"] = pd.to_datetime(frame["date"])
    frame = frame.sort_values(["asset", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    if min_periods is None:
        min_periods = max(5, window // 2)

    # 内部侧边最小样本要求
    min_side_obs = max(2, min_periods // 3)

    # close-to-close return
    ret = frame.groupby("asset", sort=False)["close"].pct_change(fill_method=None)

    # skip recent observations
    if skip_recent and skip_recent > 0:
        ret_for_signal = ret.groupby(frame["asset"], sort=False).shift(skip_recent)
    else:
        ret_for_signal = ret

    obs_count = (
        ret_for_signal.notna().astype(float)
        .groupby(frame["asset"], sort=False)
        .rolling(window=window, min_periods=1)
        .sum()
        .reset_index(level=0, drop=True)
    )

    neg_mask = ret_for_signal < 0
    pos_mask = ret_for_signal > 0

    neg_count = (
        neg_mask.astype(float)
        .groupby(frame["asset"], sort=False)
        .rolling(window=window, min_periods=1)
        .sum()
        .reset_index(level=0, drop=True)
    )
    pos_count = (
        pos_mask.astype(float)
        .groupby(frame["asset"], sort=False)
        .rolling(window=window, min_periods=1)
        .sum()
        .reset_index(level=0, drop=True)
    )

    neg_sum_sq = (
        ret_for_signal.where(neg_mask, 0.0).pow(2)
        .groupby(frame["asset"], sort=False)
        .rolling(window=window, min_periods=1)
        .sum()
        .reset_index(level=0, drop=True)
    )
    pos_sum_sq = (
        ret_for_signal.where(pos_mask, 0.0).pow(2)
        .groupby(frame["asset"], sort=False)
        .rolling(window=window, min_periods=1)
        .sum()
        .reset_index(level=0, drop=True)
    )

    down_var = neg_sum_sq.div(neg_count.where(neg_count > 0))
    up_var = pos_sum_sq.div(pos_count.where(pos_count > 0))

    valid = (
        (obs_count >= min_periods)
        & (neg_count >= min_side_obs)
        & (pos_count >= min_side_obs)
    )

    eps = 1e-12
    asym = (
        np.log(np.sqrt(down_var) + eps) - np.log(np.sqrt(up_var) + eps)
    ).where(valid)

    result = frame[["date", "asset"]].copy()
    result["factor"] = factor_name
    result["value"] = pd.Series(asym).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    return result
